content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

    if line.startswith('- '):

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        release_month_year = release_info[1] if len(release_info) > 1 else 'TODO'
        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

print(f"Found {len(songs)} songs in the note")
```

    if line.startswith('- '):

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        release_month_year = release_info[1] if len(release_info) > 1 else 'TODO'
        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

```python
content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        release_month_year = release_info[1] if len(release_info) > 1 else 'TODO'
        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

print(f"Found {len(songs)} songs in the note")
```

```python
content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        release_month_year = release_info[1] if len(release_info) > 1 else 'TODO'
        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

print(f"Found {len(songs)} songs in the note")
```

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        release_month_year = release_info[1] if len(release_info) > 1 else 'TODO'
        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        release_month_year = release_info[1] if len(release_info) > 1 else 'TODO'
        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

print(f"Found {len(songs)} songs in the note")

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')

        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year

```python
content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        release_month_year = release_info[1] if len(release_info) > 1 else 'TODO'
        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

print(f"Found {len(songs)} songs in the note")
```

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):

    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:

        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')

        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

I need to parse this content to extract song titles, artists, and update the release month information for the ones that are missing. Let me start by parsing the content.

Code:
```python
content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        release_month_year = release_info[1] if len(release_info) > 1 else 'TODO'
        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

print(f"Found {len(songs)} songs in the note")
```

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()

    if line.startswith('- '):

        if len(parts) < 2:

        song_title = parts[0]

        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        release_month_year = release_info[1] if len(release_info) > 1 else 'TODO'
        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

print(f"Found {len(songs)} songs in the note")
```

lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

    if line.startswith('- '):

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        song_title = parts[0]
        artists = parts[1].split(', ')
        release_info = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')

        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):

    if line.startswith('- '):
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) < 2:

        song_title = parts[0]

        songs.append({
            'title': song_title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_month_year': release_month_year
        })
